subject.title: fix(imessage): keep fast progress out of chat

question: Does an iMessage-area reviewer accept the bridge-backed proof once an inspectable redacted capture or transcript demonstrates both suppression of the fast-progress bubble and delivery of the final reply?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the remaining merge gate is owner assessment of real native-bridge behavior rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Request inspectable proof and review
options.body: Keep the PR open and ask for a redacted Messages capture or full transcript of the same inbound monitor run before iMessage-area acceptance.

options.title: Accept the reported run as sufficient
options.body: An iMessage reviewer may accept the copied live-run evidence if they independently trust the stated bridge setup and observed transcript.

recommendation.title: Request inspectable proof and review
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open and ask for a redacted Messages capture or full transcript of the same inbound monitor run before iMessage-area acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: jmissig is one of the explicitly named iMessage review candidates in the supplied PR timeline.
